Role & status permissions

Non-interactive reference. Switch "Signed in as" on the Pipeline screen to see these outcomes live.

ActionHRManagerInterviewerSatisfies
Mark an active, pre-offer candidate Rejected or WithdrawnAllowedAllowedDeniedAC1, AC5
Reactivate a Rejected or Withdrawn recordBlocked — 400Blocked — 400DeniedAC2, AC5
Advance a Rejected or Withdrawn record to another stageBlocked — 400Blocked — 400DeniedAC3, AC5
Mark a Deactivated candidate Rejected or WithdrawnBlocked — 400Blocked — 400DeniedAC4, AC5
Mark an Active candidate already at Offer or HiredNot offeredNot offeredNot offeredScope — "before the Offer stage"
View a Rejected or Withdrawn recordFull record shownFull record shownFull record shownAC6

A blocked attempt (Blocked — 400) is a field-level validation error: the request reaches the record, fails validation against its current status, and nothing changes. A denied attempt (Denied) never reaches validation at all — it fails the HR/Manager role check first. Viewing a record is never role- or status-gated — only changing its stage or status is.

Acceptance criteria checklist

Every acceptance criterion for this story, mapped to where it's demonstrated.

1

Marking an active, pre-offer candidate sets status to the selected outcome — AC1

As HR or Manager, "Reject" or "Withdraw" on Jordan Blake (Applied), Morgan Reyes (Phone screen) or Casey Nguyen (Interview) opens the outcome dialog; confirming sets their status chip to "Rejected" or "Withdrawn" immediately — on the Pipeline row and on the Candidate Record.

2

Reactivating a Rejected or Withdrawn record is blocked with a field-level 400 — AC2

Open Sam Okonkwo (Rejected) or Taylor Nakamura (Withdrawn) and click "Reactivate" in the Outcome block: status is unchanged and a field-level error appears directly beneath the Status field.

3

Advancing a Rejected or Withdrawn record to another stage is blocked with a field-level 400 — AC3

On the same two records, click "Advance" in the Recruiting stage block: stage is unchanged and a field-level error appears directly beneath the Stage field.

4

Marking a Deactivated candidate Rejected or Withdrawn is blocked with a field-level 400 — AC4

Open Riley Chen (Deactivated, Interview stage) and click "Reject" or "Withdraw": the outcome dialog never opens and a field-level error explains that a deactivated candidate must be reactivated first.

5

A user without HR or Manager role is denied — AC5

Switch "Signed in as" to Interviewer and attempt any action anywhere in this prototype: a "Request denied" toast appears, the outcome dialog never opens, and nothing changes — see "Role & status permissions".

6

A Rejected or Withdrawn record is distinguishable from Active and Deactivated — AC6

Every status chip pairs a distinct icon, label and border treatment — Active (✓ solid primary border), Deactivated (⏸ dashed muted border), Rejected (✕ heavy solid border), Withdrawn (↩ heavy dashed border) — visible on both the Pipeline table and the Candidate Record header.
